title: Customization
text: data_viewer_server() exposes first-class arguments common table controls: searchable filterable sortable default_page_size page_size_options lower-level reactable() overrides, use reactable_args. default_page_size must one values supplied page_size_options, page_size_options must contain positive integers.
code: data_viewer_server(   "viewer",   data = reactive(mtcars),   searchable = TRUE,   filterable = FALSE,   sortable = TRUE,   default_page_size = 25,   page_size_options = c(25, 50, 100),   reactable_args = list(     showPageInfo = FALSE   ) )

title: Customization
text: UI helpers support top bottom table controls:
code: data_viewer_card_ui(   "viewer",   table_controls_position = "bottom" )

title: Customization
text: Use plot_color either UI helper set one CSS color variable summary plots viewer. CSS color supported, including Bootstrap theme variables: plot_color NULL, plots use active Bootstrap primary color.
code: data_viewer_card_ui(   "viewer",   plot_color = "var(--bs-success)" )

title: Customization
text: Use summary_card_fn replace default variable card renderer keeping module’s summary computation table logic. custom function must accept least summary_row index, summary_row one-row data frame produced summarize_columns(). typical use case treating identifier-like columns differently ordinary categorical fields, example suppressing mini chart showing “High cardinality” badge instead. module validates unsupported column classes early, custom summary-card logic can assume incoming summary_row corresponds one supported viewer types.
code: custom_summary_card <- function(summary_row, index) {   htmltools::tags$div(     class = "custom-summary-card",     htmltools::tags$strong(summary_row$var_name[[1]]),     htmltools::tags$span(sprintf(" (%s)", summary_row$type[[1]]))   ) }  data_viewer_server(   "viewer",   data = reactive(iris),   summary_card_fn = custom_summary_card )

title: Customization
text: module styles use Bootstrap variables, follow active bslib theme brand.yml values automatically. also respond live light dark mode changes bslib::input_dark_mode() bslib::toggle_dark_mode().
code: ui <- page_fillable(   theme = bs_theme(version = 5, brand = "brand.yml"),   data_viewer_card_ui("viewer") )

title: Get Started
text: Use data_viewer_ui() viewer manage table card.
code: ui <- page_fillable(   theme = bs_theme(version = 5),   data_viewer_ui("viewer") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   data_viewer_server(     "viewer",     data = reactive(iris)   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Get Started
text: Use data_viewer_card_ui() viewer belongs inside another layout.
code: ui <- page_fillable(   theme = bs_theme(version = 5),   layout_columns(     col_widths = c(4, 8),     card(       card_header("Context"),       card_body("Supporting content")     ),     data_viewer_card_ui(       "viewer",       title = "Dataset",       full_screen = FALSE     )   ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   data_viewer_server(     "viewer",     data = reactive(mtcars)   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Get Started
text: variable sidebar backed summarize_columns(). summarize_columns() returns one row per input column. summary_stats distribution_data list-columns contain precomputed payloads used viewer cards, including detail statistics, categorical top-level counts, compact histogram metadata.
code: summary_df <- summarize_columns(head(iris), top_n = 4)  summary_df[c("var_name", "type", "n_missing", "n_unique")] #>                  var_name    type n_missing n_unique #> Sepal.Length Sepal.Length numeric         0        6 #> Sepal.Width   Sepal.Width numeric         0        6 #> Petal.Length Petal.Length numeric         0        4 #> Petal.Width   Petal.Width numeric         0        2 #> Species           Species  factor         0        1

title: Reusable Data Viewer Module for shiny
text: Install shinydataviewer CRAN: can install development version GitHub:
code: install.packages("shinydataviewer") pak::pak("Ryan-W-Harrison/shinydataviewer")

title: Reusable Data Viewer Module for shiny
text: shinydataviewer designed used reusable Shiny module. main exported functions : data_viewer_ui(id) data_viewer_server(id, data) data_viewer_card_ui(id, title = NULL) summarize_columns(df) UI helpers accept plot_color customize variable-summary mini plots viewer CSS color, "var(--bs-success)". data reactive expression returns data.frame. Supported column classes numeric, integer, character, factor, logical, Date, POSIXct/POSIXt, hms/difftime.

title: Reusable Data Viewer Module for shiny
text: Use module directly want viewer layout manage main table region:
code: library(shiny) library(bslib) library(shinydataviewer)  ui <- page_fillable(   theme = bs_theme(version = 5),   data_viewer_ui("viewer") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   data_viewer_server(     "viewer",     data = reactive(iris)   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Reusable Data Viewer Module for shiny
text: Use data_viewer_card_ui() viewer needs live inside larger dashboard reporting layout: additional runnable example included inst/examples/embedded-card-example.R.
code: library(shiny) library(bslib) library(shinydataviewer)  ui <- page_fillable(   theme = bs_theme(version = 5),   layout_columns(     col_widths = c(4, 8),     card(       card_header("Context"),       card_body("Supporting content goes here.")     ),     card(       card_header("Dataset"),       card_body(         fill = TRUE,         data_viewer_card_ui("viewer", title = NULL, full_screen = FALSE)       )     )   ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   data_viewer_server(     "viewer",     data = reactive(mtcars)   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Reusable Data Viewer Module for shiny
text: app inst/examples/upload-dataset/ lets users upload CSV RDS file displays resulting data frame shinydataviewer card. Run package checkout : installed copy package, use:
code: shiny::runApp("inst/examples/upload-dataset") shiny::runApp(   system.file("examples/upload-dataset", package = "shinydataviewer") )

title: Reusable Data Viewer Module for shiny
text: viewer styles attached package dependency use Bootstrap 5 theme variables instead fixed colors. practice, means module follow active bslib theme pick branding supplied bs_theme() brand.yml-driven theme without additional module-specific configuration. viewer also follows live Bootstrap color-mode changes made bslib::input_dark_mode() bslib::toggle_dark_mode(), including reactable table variable-summary sidebar.
code: ui <- page_fillable(   theme = bs_theme(     version = 5,     brand = "brand.yml"   ),   data_viewer_card_ui("viewer") )

title: Reusable Data Viewer Module for shiny
text: want access summary data used module’s variable panel, can call summarize_columns() directly: returned data frame one row per input column. summary_stats distribution_data list-columns contain precomputed payloads used sidebar cards, including compact statistics, histogram bins, top-level categorical counts.
code: summarize_columns(iris)

title: Data Viewer Module Server — data_viewer_server
text: id Module id. data Reactive returning data frame. Supported column classes numeric, integer, character, factor, logical, Date, POSIXct/POSIXt, hms/difftime. top_n Maximum number categorical levels keep compact summary views collapsing remainder "". default_page_size Optional default number rows show table. NULL, module shows rows largest page-size option. page_size_options Page-size options shown table controls. searchable Whether table search box enabled. filterable Whether column filters enabled. sortable Whether column sorting enabled. summary_card_fn Function used render variable summary card. must accept least (summary_row, index) return Shiny UI tag. reactable_theme Optional reactable::reactableTheme() object. NULL, module uses built-theme. default_col_def Optional default reactable::colDef() apply columns. NULL, module uses built-default column definition. reactable_args Optional named list additional arguments passed reactable::reactable(). values override module defaults.

title: Data Viewer Module Server — data_viewer_server
code: custom_summary_card <- function(summary_row, index) {   htmltools::tags$div(     class = "custom-summary-card",     sprintf("%s: %s", summary_row$var_name[[1]], summary_row$type[[1]])   ) }  ui <- bslib::page_fillable(   theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5),   data_viewer_card_ui("viewer", title = "Iris") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   data_viewer_server(     "viewer",     data = shiny::reactive(iris),     searchable = TRUE,     filterable = TRUE,     sortable = TRUE,     summary_card_fn = custom_summary_card   ) }  if (interactive()) {   shiny::shinyApp(ui, server) }
